color.reference.shadow.elevated.description: Paper's soft elevation shadow color used by cards and material recipes.

color.reference.shadow.overlay.description: Paper's overlay shadow color used by material recipes.

dimension.reference.control.description: 40px at the default root size; the default compact interactive dimension.

duration.control.description: State transitions on an interactive control: hover, press, focus.

duration.surface.description: Surfaces entering or leaving: popovers, dialogs, disclosure.

radius.reference.full.description: Pill / circle. Large enough to always clamp to half the shorter edge.

radius.control.description: Corner radius for interactive controls: buttons, inputs, chips.

radius.container.description: Corner radius for surfaces that contain other content: cards, panels, dialogs.

radius.pill.description: Fully rounded. For badges and toggles whose shape is part of their meaning.

space.controlInline.description: Inline (left/right) padding inside an interactive control at the default size.

space.controlBlock.description: Block (top/bottom) padding inside an interactive control at the default size.

space.controlGap.description: Gap between a control's own parts, e.g. between a button's icon and its label.

space.containerInline.description: Inline padding inside a surface container such as a card.

space.containerBlock.description: Block padding inside a surface container such as a card.

space.containerGap.description: Gap between sibling regions inside a container, e.g. a card's header and its content.

space.groupRelated.description: Tight spacing between parts that form one semantic value or control.

space.groupInline.description: Default spacing between sibling nodes grouped on the inline axis.

space.groupBlock.description: Default spacing between sibling nodes grouped on the block axis.

space.region.description: Separation between distinct semantic regions in a larger surface composition.

fontFamily.reference.sans.value: 'SF Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

layer.raised.description: Controls or local overlays raised above adjacent content.

layer.overlay.description: Floating surfaces and their dismissal layers.

layer.inspection.description: Developer inspection affordances that must remain above the rendered surface.

layout.dimension.zero.description: A zero minimum that permits a nested region to shrink and scroll correctly.

layout.dimension.glyph.description: A compact icon, indicator, or spinner measure.

layout.dimension.control.description: The default compact interactive block or inline measure.

layout.dimension.compact.description: A compact supporting region or short value measure.

layout.dimension.supporting.description: A small supporting region or minimum workspace pane measure.

layout.dimension.panel.description: A supporting panel's preferred or minimum inline measure.

layout.dimension.inspector.description: A contextual inspector's preferred or maximum inline measure.

layout.dimension.dialog.description: A focused dialog or confirmation surface's maximum inline measure.

layout.dimension.measure.description: A readable maximum line or form measure.

layout.dimension.content.description: A broad content surface's maximum inline measure.

layout.dimension.record.description: A broad structured record surface's maximum inline measure.

border.focusRing.description: Thickness of the focus indicator. Paired with color.focusRing.

border.focusRingOffset.description: Gap between the control's edge and its focus ring.

type.body.fontFamily.value: 'SF Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

type.label.fontFamily.value: 'SF Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

type.labelSmall.fontFamily.value: 'SF Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

type.labelLarge.fontFamily.value: 'SF Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

type.heading.fontFamily.value: 'SF Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

color.canvas.description: The page behind everything. Never put text directly on it without a surface.

color.surface.description: Default raised content surface: cards, panels, sheets.

color.surfaceRaised.description: A surface above another surface. In the light theme elevation reads through shadow, so this matches `surface`; in the dark theme it steps lighter instead.

color.surfaceSunken.description: A recessed well inside a surface: code blocks, inset lists, track backgrounds.

color.textMuted.description: Secondary text: captions, help text, metadata. Still meets 4.5:1 on `surface`.

color.textDisabled.description: Text in a disabled control. Deliberately below 4.5:1 — disabled content is exempt, and the low contrast is the affordance.

color.borderStrong.description: Emphasised outline: hovered controls, active field borders.

color.focusRing.description: Keyboard focus indicator. Paired with border.focusRing / border.focusRingOffset.

color.shadow.description: Elevation shadow colour. Components own the shadow's geometry; the theme owns its colour, because how much a shadow reads depends entirely on what it sits on.

color.action.description: The accent tone. Primary buttons, links, selected state.

color.onAction.description: Ink foreground for content sitting on `action`; the Paper primary blue does not carry white text at accessible body sizes.

color.neutral.description: The neutral tone. Secondary buttons and low-emphasis fills.

color.positive.description: The positive tone. Success, confirmation, safe-to-proceed.

color.warning.description: The warning tone. Needs attention but is not an error.

color.onWarning.description: Dark rather than light: amber is too bright to carry white text at 4.5:1.

color.critical.description: The critical tone. Errors and destructive actions.
